Message From The Leadership
Dr. D. HEMACHANDRA SAGAR
Chancellor, Dayananda Sagar University

Join me in taking the first steps as we set up the Dayananda Sagar University (DSU) that is backed by the legacy of Dayananda Sagar Institutions. The Year 2015 would be one more major milestone in our pursuit of excellence in the higher education space opening up a significant opportunity to the community that we belong to. DSU is committed to give more now and in the days to come by designing academic programs that reflect present societal needs and that of the distant future.

This knowledge would vest a new power and intellect in an individual. The education and training at DSU allows a young graduate to be seen as a proficient & master, in a chosen domain. The journey of the past five decades in our campuses is one of great fulfillment witnessed by the successes that we have achieved; encouraging us to develop a new vision – to achieve newer goals to be realized in the years to come. Welcome to Dayananda Sagar University and wishing all of you a great future! BEST WISHES!
Dr. D. PREMACHANDRA SAGAR
Pro-Chancellor, Dayananda Sagar University

Success comes to the hard working and creative. But even the best and focused young man & woman with complete dedication & involvement needs institutional leadership, a matching ambience, a responsive culture and perfect support allowing easy access that include: intellectual, infrastructure and all other critical needs. These diverse requirements are systematically arranged & consciously put together on a single platform and now converge at one place: Dayananda Sagar University.

As you move around the campus, you should be ready to witness several pleasant surprises; to find all these and more in an academic campus in India, simply because it is unusual; though seen as normal in the more developed nations. Thankfully India that is in great change mode is seeing a new vision now on a free rein! Dayananda Sagar University (DSU) is setting its base on getting the best: The most competent individuals – who are accomplished scientists, researchers, academicians from across the finest universities in the world. A global search for the greatest and proven individuals has met with the first successes, encouraging us to pursue this path with greater vigor.
Prof B. S. SATYANARAYANA
Vice-Chancellor, Dayananda Sagar University

We are in rapidly changing world where Knowledge life cycles have reduced drastically, and product and process life cycles are getting even shorter. Especially India is rapidly progressing to once again become a global leader, that it had always been for nearly 90% of the last 2000 years.

This calls for education to deliver knowledge, skill and integrated experiential learning to enable the learner to cope with the dynamically changing world. Dayananda Sagar University has set a vision to enable the learner to excel in education, research, innovation & entrepreneurship for a Sustainable tomorrow, as per their own aspirations and goals. We are sure the young university and the Founder’s efforts to create a truly state of art campus, with a unique, serene and conducive ambience for a multidisciplinary immersive experiential learning, will truly empower not just the learn but the state, the nation and the world at large.

So welcome to Dayananda Sagar University and we wish you all a bright future, as you embark on your life journey. We assure you that the university will always be a steadfast partner and mentor to you for life in this age of learners.
DR. PUTTAMADAPPA C
Registrar, Dayananda Sagar University
We are excited to welcome you to the new and dynamic Centre for Distance and Online Education at Dayananda Sagar University.

We have always spoken about online learning as the next, most crucial step in education at DSU, and what a proud moment it is to be a part of this growing effort to educate through different mediums. By integrating ICT, DSU online elevates learning to meet the ever-evolving demands of rapidly changing industries.

I am proud to say that DSU Online is at par with all the universities on a global scale, with our curriculum designed to enable our students to compete with the best of the best and come out shining. Furthermore, our programmes are designed in such a way that our students not only excel in academics and meet industry standards, but also develop the practical skills required to contribute to society. After all, as Astor says, “Real education should educate us out of self into something far finer, into a selflessness which links us with all humanity.”
DR. ANUPAMA G
Professor & Director CDOE, Dayananda Sagar University
Welcome to Dayananda Sagar University, Centre for Distance and Online Education. You have taken the first step towards academic excellence by placing your trust in this institution.

At DSU Centre for Distance and Online Education (CDOE), we aim to provide education that is holistic and enables students to be leaders and change-makers of this society. Education ensures that you have a place in the world, one that you carve for yourself. To take it one step further, education enables you to create space for others in the world as well. This, dear students, is what education can offer. DSU Online makes it easy for students to balance other commitments with their education owing to the flexible nature of the programmes offered.
How DSU Online Ensures Quality Education?

Dayananda Sagar University (DSU) Online blends the excellence of traditional academic delivery with innovative digital learning methodologies. With technology-driven education, DSU Online ensures a highly engaging and industry-aligned learning experience.

Supported by expert faculty and advanced online learning tools, the platform enables students to grow, collaborate, innovate, and build impactful careers across corporate, public, research, and academic domains.
Advantages of Studying at Dayananda Sagar University Online

items: Flexible programmes designed to help students balance academics with work or personal commitments.
Modern ICT tools ensure seamless, high-quality digital learning accessible anytime, anywhere.
Students gain hands-on skills by working on innovative solutions for real-world societal and industrial challenges.
Strong exposure to legal, cultural, environmental, and societal aspects—preparing students for holistic decision-making.
Emphasis on ethics, sustainability, teamwork, and leadership enhances personal and professional maturity.
Encourages continuous learning to stay updated with the fast-changing business and technological landscape.

items: Quadrant-I, i.e., e-Tutorial, faculty-led video and audio contents

Quadrant-IV, i.e., self-assessment, in the form of MCQs, problems, quizzes, assignments with solutions.
